titleInfo.title: U.S. Army uniform shirt and tie from World War II

mods.abstract: This uniform was worn by Ruth Beery, head nurse of the 8th Evacuation Hospital unit of the U.S. Army, during World War II. Khaki colored shirt with maroon tie; shirt: plastic buttons, (2) flap breast pockets, Saks Fifth Avenue, U508 11 36 stamped on inside, Ruth Beery sewn; tie: Shillito's Men's store, Cincinnati, 11-21 tacked on inside, Ruth Beery sewn.
mods.note: Photographed by Claude Moore Health Sciences Library, Historical Collections and Services staff.
